name: hero
facts: Every settled answer becomes one binary check on the bar, judged by either 'run it' or 'A/B pick' and nothing else
A reference is named only where an A/B pick needs one; a run-it check records an em dash instead
Undecided items are enumerated U1, U2 and marked not gradeable rather than guessed
scripts/check_answer_key.py lints the emitted answer key before anything is built against it
